g.text: Above the diagonal: a higher aged-65+ share in 2022. Descriptive endpoint comparison.
Sources: Census Vintage 2020 evaluation (2011) and Vintage 2022 (2022); Japan official long-term and 2022 tables.
Census bases and revisions differ across periods; changes include benchmark effects and are not causal estimates.
